summary_en: This study tests selinexor, given as maintenance treatment after CAR-T cell therapy (cilta-cel) in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, a blood cancer. Selinexor is taken orally as tablets on Days 1, 8, 15, and 22 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 12 cycles, starting at Day 30 or after Day 58 after the CAR-T infusion. The study aims to measure the safety and toxicity of selinexor; this is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa selinexor, administrado como tratamiento de mantenimiento después de la terapia con células CAR-T (cilta-cel) en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario, un cáncer de la sangre. El selinexor se toma por vía oral en tabletas los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de cada ciclo de 28 días, por hasta 12 ciclos, comenzando el día 30 o después del día 58 tras la infusión de CAR-T. El estudio busca medir la seguridad y la toxicidad del selinexor; es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that returned or did not respond, after at least one prior line including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent.
High-risk features such as certain chromosome or gene changes, high beta-2-microglobulin, or extramedullary disease, or MRD-positive disease in standard-risk my
Received or planning to receive standard cilta-cel CAR-T therapy, with ability to monitor response by ClonoSEQ MRD testing.
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or less, and adequate blood counts and organ function.
not_for: Active myeloma involving the central nervous system.
Confirmed disease progression after CAR-T therapy.
Unresolved cytokine release syndrome or CAR-T neurologic toxicity.
Prior selinexor or another XPO1 inhibitor after CAR-T therapy.
Uncontrolled infection, serious heart problems, pregnancy, or breastfeeding.
